title: Jobs That Keep a Town Running
summary: Meet the helpers around us: doctors, farmers, drivers, teachers and more.

steps.title: Helpers everywhere
sentences: Many people work to keep our town running.
Farmers grow our food, bakers make bread and shopkeepers sell what we need.
Each job is useful and each worker deserves respect.

steps.title: Health and safety
sentences: Doctors and nurses help us when we are ill.
Firefighters put out fires and police keep people safe.
Sanitation workers keep our streets clean, which keeps us healthy.

steps.title: Learning and building
sentences: Teachers help us learn, and librarians help us find books.
Engineers and masons build roads, bridges and houses.
Electricians and plumbers fix the lights and the water.

steps.title: What will you be?
sentences: Some jobs are old, and some are brand new, like drone pilots and app makers.
Think about what you enjoy and what you are good at.
You can also change your mind many times as you grow.

facts: A single bridge needs many different workers, from designers to welders.
Postal workers in India deliver letters to even remote villages.
Farmers in India feed more than a billion people.

quiz.q: Who helps us when we are ill?
quiz.why: Doctors and nurses care for the sick.

quiz.q: Whose job helps us find books?
quiz.why: A librarian helps you find books.
